answer: Commit-reveal split across 3 auditors who never see each other's shares. Hash at commit, split the payload 3 ways, count a reveal only when 2 shares match, so one bought auditor cannot pass a fake. A farm pays 3x coordination per submission and needs 2 independent hosts per seat, about 6 machines for 2 seats. The velvet of it is that nothing shows until reveal, an ember of a copied hash dies at the second share, and the whole bridge from commit to reveal is 12 blocks.
